捐款

下表列出了中国妇女俱乐部在今年四月和五月期间的捐款情况。尽管这些捐款总额达9,810美元，但如“捐款”标题下页面所示，俱乐部已竭尽所能应对国家危机。此外，俱乐部每月平均支付500美元，以维持为其服务的贫困儿童开办的免费学校。所有这些均未包含在“活动摘要”中提到的1936-1937年度捐款（总额为9,428美元）之内。

这些捐款得以实现，有赖于我们年度慈善舞会筹集的资金以及朋友们的馈赠。鉴于目前因中日敌对行动造成的局势，这些收入来源现已对我们关闭。因此，希望能从其他渠道获得支持，以便我们可以继续这项必要的工作。

December 8, 1937.

Commissioner F. W. Gerrard,
185 Foochow Road,
Shanghai.

Dear Sir:

In our efforts to provide relief for the
myriads of destitute women and children
refugees we are this year adopting the
charming American custom of Christmas
seals. Every seal provides a refugee a
meal. We are sending you five hundred
seals, which we sincerely hope you and
your associates will use on your Christ-
mas letters, cards and packages this
year. The seals are being sold at five
cents a piece. Checks should be made
out payable to the Chinese Women's Club
and forwarded to me at your earliest
convenience.

Your generosity in response to this ap-
peal will be sincerely appreciated and
may yours be a Merry Christmas and a
Happy New Year.

Very sincerely yours,

Mrs. Chauncey K. Wu
Secretary
Chinese Women's Club

F. W. Gerrard 警务处处长，
上海福州路185号，

尊敬的先生：

在我们努力为成千上万贫困的妇女儿童难民提供救济之际，今年我们采用了迷人的美国习俗——圣诞印章。每一枚印章可为一名难民提供一顿饭。我们向您寄送五百枚印章，真诚希望您和您的同事在今年的圣诞信件、卡片和包裹上使用它们。印章售价为每枚五分。支票请抬头写给中国妇女俱乐部，并请您尽早寄给我。

对于这一呼吁，您的慷慨解囊将受到诚挚的感激，祝您圣诞快乐，新年幸福。

您非常真诚的，

Chauncey K. Wu 夫人
秘书
中国妇女俱乐部

Date December 15, 19 37
Subject The Chinese Women's Club of Shanghai - issue of Christmas seals
to raise funds for the relief of refugees.
Made by.................... and .................... Forwarded by D.I. Crawford

The Chinese Women's Club of Shanghai has its
headquarters in the Y.W.C.A., 999 Bubbling Well Road,
and has as its object the relief of distressed people
and assistance to refugees. The refugee problem being
of paramount importance at present it was decided at a
meeting of the Chinese Women's Club held at the beginning
of December, to adopt the scheme as used extensively in
the U.S.A. at Christmas of issuing seasonal seals for
parcels and cards and so obtain money for the relief of
refugees. The order for the seals was given to
Millington Ltd., who are executing the work at a cheaper
rate and 5,000 have been printed. It is the intention
of the Club to distribute those seals in lots according
to the standing of the recipient, through personal
friends of the committee and people of well known
standing in the community, and none will be sold in
public places. The total proceeds received will be
devoted to the relief of refugees.

The Chinese Women's Club is composed of women
who are all well known in social circles and belong to
prominent Chinese families connected with banking and
commerce, as will be seen in the following list:-

主题 上海中国妇女俱乐部 - 发行圣诞印章以筹集难民救济资金。
制作人.................... 和 .................... 由警督 Crawford 转呈

上海中国妇女俱乐部总部设在静安寺路999号的基督教女青年会，其宗旨是救济受灾民众并援助难民。鉴于难民问题目前至关重要，中国妇女俱乐部在12月初举行的会议上决定，采用美国圣诞节期间广泛使用的方案，即发行用于包裹和卡片的季节性印章，从而为救济难民筹集资金。印章订单已下达给 Millington 有限公司，该公司以较低的价格承印，目前已印制5,000枚。俱乐部打算根据受赠者的地位，通过委员会的个人朋友和社会知名人士分批分发这些印章，不在公共场所出售。所得全部款项将用于救济难民。

中国妇女俱乐部由社交界知名女性组成，她们均出身于与银行业和商业有关的显赫中国家庭，名单如下：-
